coverage_gap: No rendered show-more visual acceptance.

rule: Determine leading/trailing anchors from retained compact text beside the edge marker, not raw punctuation offsets.
After raw/grapheme failure, apply precomputed direct directional grapheme patterns with one shared query-wide cost/depth budget.
threshold_or_value: visible5..7: depth1 cost<=1.00; visible8..24: depth2 cost<=1.40; cap512

rule: Match complete exact family and distinct family head, but deduplicate and identify results by exact family.compact rather than broad variant group.
Compact visible parts, discard empty parts, retain 1..4 fragments, and require >=2 total visible characters.
After all exact stages fail, share at most one ordinary edit over all fragments; require visible total>=5 and every fragment length>=2.
After raw failure, align fixed grapheme-equivalent keys while preserving source-target width projection for metrics.
threshold_or_value: stage=1; PH/F, CK/K, GH/G, C/K, Q/K, repeated-glyph collapse

rule: Every explicit internal/leading/trailing gap consumes >=1 target character in raw, grapheme, direct-confusion, and fuzzy paths; shorthand permits zero-width joins.
threshold_or_value: minimum adds internal gaps and unanchored explicit edges

rule: Recognize runs of >=2 dots, >=1 Unicode ellipsis, >=1 asterisk, >=1 question mark, or >=2 underscores as explicit gaps.
First attempt literal ordered fragment alignment with requested anchors and one-or-more hidden target characters for every explicit gap.
Report bounded visible edit for nonzero direct/fuzzy distance and grapheme confusion for nonzero direct operation count; never emit obsolete one-visible-edit reason.
Return ambiguous, low-confidence, confirmation-required visual responses; explicit syntax remains visual even with no matches, shorthand falls through when empty.
Do not reinterpret shorthand when concatenated fragments already equal an exact family whose normalized spelling equals the query.
Only 2..4 whitespace-separated ASCII alphabetic tokens of length >=2 become marker-free shorthand; punctuation-separated words stay ordinary search.
Sort exact-family matches by stage, visible distance, confusion count, hidden characters, descending coverage, head/full target type, family length, then name.
Compute hidden_character_count and visible_coverage from target characters consumed by the chosen alignment, including variable-length grapheme/direct/fuzzy rewrites.
